product_metadata.title: SINOBEST Wood Step Stool, Portable Rectangle Bed Stool, Small Step Ladder for Kitchen & Bathroom, Foot Rest Stool Under Desk, Large Surface, Strong and Durable for Kids, Adults and Elders
features: NATURAL MATERIALS: Crafted from 100% natural wood, which is lightweight and sturdy, relieves your fatigue and benefit to your health. Beautiful natural wood texture on surface gives you good feeling. (Attention: please don't expose the stool to sunlight or humidity for a long time to avoid the cracking on the surface.)

LARGE SURFACE & STURDY: The dimension of the stool is 16" Wide x 10" Deep x 5.5" High (Foldable 2” High ) with big capability. Large surface is easy and comfortable to step up to. (Note: If you find the leg can't attach the body properly, please change the two legs each other and try again.)
PORTABLE:This wooden stool is good designed, easy to assemble and storable, very portable. You can put it in your bag and take it outdoors for a picnic.
RELAX YOUR FOOT: No matter you are with shoes or not, this foot rest stool will be your best working foot partner. Also, you can use it whether you are at home or at office anytime.
IDEAL STEP STOOL: The stool as an ideal step stool matches for your bed, kitchen, bathroom or your massage table. Even works as bed table or laptop stand.
